banned.why: every random number comes from a seed: Rng / deriveSeed (@futuremagic/core)
one renderer, made by createRenderer from @futuremagic/stage
Solarpolis is WebGPU only, with no WebGL fallback (Arnd, 2026-10-21)
workers are created by the one worker pool
every material is a kind in the registry, so warm-up knows every shader (docs/SHADERS.md)
a mesh given up goes through freeMesh (render/geometry.ts): disposing only its geometry leaves three's WebGPU renderer holding the whole mesh
shader variants come from the registry's TSL kinds, not from patched source (docs/SHADERS.md)
compiling is the Stage's job (@futuremagic/stage): warmUp(), warmLater() and add() (docs/SHADERS.md)
lights are a fixed pool made before the warm-up: the light count is part of every shader's cache key (docs/SHADERS.md)
every LLM call goes through src/llm (model roster, task routing, usage tracking)
the pure layers are deterministic: time is injected
memory is read by the one watchdog (src/app/memory.ts)

layers.why: the blueprint is the root of everything: pure numbers, no three.js, nothing above it
the generator is pure data: it runs in workers and headless tests
the space model (clock, ephemeris, frames, the Necklace) is pure: windows, the title flight, workers and tests all read it
world queries are pure: gameplay, workers and tests use them
the society sim is pure: it runs in a worker and in headless tests
what people say is pure: the conversation engine runs in a worker and in headless tests
the renderer does not know about the app or the Lab
persistence is a leaf: everything may save and load through it
